instruction: Delete all .pdf files from my file system ~/downloads folder.
notes: Single-app task (file_system). The agent logs in, lists ~/downloads with substring '.pdf' (one show_directory call reveals all pdf paths, modeled by (directory-listed dir substring) which unlocks delete_file for every file statically marked as being in that directory with that extension), then deletes each pdf. The number of pdf files is unknown a priori; two placeholder file objects are used (consistent with the 6-call reference solution), and at runtime one delete_file call is issued per pdf path returned. supervisor-complete-task takes the two file records as non-API parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal (all pdfs deleted) without hardcoding problem objects in the domain; no answer is passed since the task is not a question. Non-pdf files must not be deleted (only files with (has-extension f substring-pdf) are deletable).
